lines.zh: 我在你身后走，不紧不慢
lines.en: I walk behind you, unhurried.
I time my steps to miss yours.
I take the outer side, by the rail.
You round the corner; I stop.
When you're far enough, I follow.
I want to know where you're going.

lines.zh: 这个好奇心，我没法控制
lines.en: I can't control this curiosity.

lines.zh: 我贴着地板走，没有声音
lines.en: I move flat along the floor, silent.

lines.zh: 我绕过水洼，怕留下痕迹
lines.en: I skirt the puddle to leave no trace.
I haven't figured you out yet.

lines.zh: 我站在楼梯口，看你上楼
lines.en: I stand at the stairs and watch you climb.

lines.zh: 我保持距离，歪着头看你。
lines.en: I keep my distance and tilt my head.
Why aren't you afraid?
I've thought about it a long while.
All the others ran.
You just stand and look at me.
I'm not used to this.

lines.zh: 我又靠近了一点，然后又退
lines.en: I come closer, then withdraw again.
This isn't a chase. It's study.

lines.zh: 你手上的动作很有意思
lines.en: The way you move your hands is interesting.
When will you tire?
I want the answer.
The lamp's on you. You don't notice me.
I tilt my head and copy your stance.
I can watch a long time.
Longer than you'd think.
When I come close, you should run.
You actually didn't run.
So we look at each other.
Your eyes are steady.
That surprises me a little.

lines.zh: 我往前半步，看你退不退
lines.en: I take half a step. Will you move?
You didn't give an inch.
Then half a step more.
Why are you looking at me like that?
I ought to withdraw.
But I simply don't want to.
I tilt my head the other way.
Your breathing is calm.
Not like someone about to die.

lines.zh: 你闭眼之前，我记住了你。
lines.en: Before you shut your eyes, I memorized you.
I give half a step, still watching.
Did you strike me because you're afraid?
I've noted that reaction.
A little of my shape disperses.

lines.zh: 我不生气，只是更想看了
lines.en: I'm not angry. I only want to watch more.
Your hand is shaking.
So you do get afraid.
That makes sense now.
I'm curious whether that hurts.

lines.zh: 我的脖子歪了一下，又正了。
lines.en: My neck twisted, then straightened.
You reach out; I watch the hand.
I don't understand that thing.
Are you trying to bring me closer?
I don't need this thing.

lines.zh: 不过你举着的样子有趣
lines.en: But the way you hold it is interesting.
What's it for?
Lower it and I'll look again.
I don't eat. I only look.
Does that thing in your hand make a sound?
And why is that?

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我们都很意外
lines.en: You bump me. We're both surprised.
I step back. Not from fear.
A little of your warmth comes through.
You bump me, and I give half a step.
Hand meets hand; I pause a beat.
That brought me nearer.
You didn't pull your hand back.
Then I won't withdraw either.

lines.zh: 我们之间没剩下多少距离
lines.en: There's very little distance left between us.
This distance confuses me.

lines.zh: 我想知道你会不会留下
lines.en: I want to know if you'll stay.
I've never asked this before.
I'll just stand here and watch you.
Just don't leave at once.
I can sit here and watch.
Watch what you do.

lines.zh: 走路的样子，说话的样子
lines.en: How you walk. How you speak.
I haven't seen enough of it.

lines.zh: 你睡着以后，我也不会走
lines.en: When you sleep, I still won't go.
I'd like to see what a dream looks like.
I pick it up and look at it.
What's this made of?
I hold it to the light and turn it.
I don't understand it, but I'll keep it.
You dropped this. I picked it up.
I hold it out; you don't take it.

lines.zh: 我放在我们中间的地上
lines.en: I set it on the floor between us.
Now either of us could touch it.
I mean nothing by it.
It's only a little curiosity.
I understand what you're doing now.
You want me to come over.
Then I'll walk over.
I'm done keeping my distance.
After this step, there's no going back.
And still I walk over.
Your hands are ready.
I saw all of it.
But I don't care in the least.
I want to come close and see clearly.
What expression is that on your face?
I want to remember it.
Don't move for a moment.
Let me have a good look.
Just this once is enough.
There. I've seen it.
Now I've seen it clearly.
Thank you, truly I mean it.

lines.zh: 我保持距离，一圈一圈跟着。
lines.en: I keep my distance, circling.
From here you look different.
I move to the other side.
I can see better like this.
Your shadow turns with me.
I won't tire of this game.

lines.zh: 你每动一下，我就学一次
lines.en: Every move you make, I learn once.
Your shoulders. Your hands.
I've noted all of these.
Now it's my turn to move.
This step of mine will be quick.
Can you react in time?
I'd very much like to try.
Just a little more distance closed.
To where my hand can reach.

lines.zh: 我想看清你手里拿着什么。
lines.en: I want a closer look at what you're holding.

lines.zh: 你闭着眼，也感觉得到我。
lines.en: Eyes shut, and you still feel me.
See? I've reached you.
So this is how close it is.
I don't much want to pull back.
I touch your face.
Just a touch. Nothing more.
Your skin is cooler than it looks.
I pull my hand back, then reach again.
I put a little force into this one.
I reach out, fingertips grazing you.
Why is that?
I only wanted to understand.
Understand this distance.
Understand whether you feel pain.
Did that hurt just now?
Your expression changed.
So that's how it works.

lines.zh: 我碰了碰你的肩，就退开。
lines.en: I touch your shoulder, then pull back.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯的暗处看下来
lines.en: I watch from the shadow on the stairs.

lines.zh: 这里的东西我都没见过
lines.en: I've not seen anything here before.
First curiosity, then approach.
I lean out to look down the corridor.
No one at all. Except you.
You have light, and a smell.
I want to know what it is.
Half my face comes into view.
I stand still at the edge of your sight.
This suits best, as it happens.
I can watch a while longer.
How you walk. How you stop.
How you get afraid.
Or simply not be afraid.
I'm already curious.
That's not a good sign.
And yet I don't want to stop.
So I'll look closer.
Close enough to see your eyes.
You've turned around.
Fire shows my shape; I draw back.

lines.zh: 我往下坠，还抬着头看你
lines.en: I fall, head still up toward you.
Water fills in and I can't see.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推远，我又回头
lines.en: The blast pushes me off; I turn back.
The arrow passes through; I stare at the fletching.
Too bright. I shut my eyes.
I'm hungry, but more curious.

lines.zh: 那道光把整间屋子照白
lines.en: That flash turns the whole room white.
Nothing at all. Except you.
